question: What explains the apparent manifoldness of consciousness and power despite their unchanging nature?
premises: Intrinsic mutability would imply real change
The text attributes their variety to limiting conditions
inference: The manifoldness of consciousness and power is only conditioned, not intrinsic.
uncertainties: The exact referent of ślo0 19 is not specified in this unit.
plain_english: Because mutability is denied, the text says that the manifoldness of those two is only due to limiting conditions.
